scope: synthetic lifecycle-observability discrimination only; no product credit

external_expectation.rule: Expectations are authorable ex ante and contain no runtime identity, Location, snapshot, raw Span or candidate-declared coverage.

rules: runtime identity is unique within one cell
each runtime object binds to exactly one stable role from the pinned manifest
each required stable role has exactly its externally required multiplicity
all event references resolve within the same cell
execution start precedes observations and execution end follows them
causal graph over runtime objects is acyclic
callback Func and carrier roles, feature origin, counter key/action/occurrence/span role, and recursive ordered Dict payload are checked before opacity

classification.Preserved: all schema, external completeness, static binding, within-cell bijection, semantic and causal checks pass and payload is inspectable
classification.Unknown: all preceding checks pass and payload_state is explicitly opaque with an allowlisted reason
classification.Violated: any missing/malformed/self-declared binding, semantic mismatch, bijection failure, causal failure, or opacity hiding such a failure

limitations: This initial contract is not a seal and grants no implementation or product verdict.
The exact historical names of the 12 R6 known mutants were not present in the allowed inputs; the focal maps them bijectively as R6-INHERIT-01..04, R6-OMISSION-01..03 and R6-MISSING-OPAQUE-01..05.
Static binding owner/callsite labels are independent semantic roles, not proof that product hooks exist; reachability remains a later verifier gate against pinned owners.
No candidate, P1340 implementation, candidate output or candidate receipt was read.
